```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(pheatmap)

flattenCorrMatrix <- function(cormat, pmat) {
  ut <- upper.tri(cormat)
  data.frame(
    row = rownames(cormat)[row(cormat)[ut]],
    column = rownames(cormat)[col(cormat)[ut]],
    cor  =(cormat)[ut],
    p = pmat[ut]
    )
}

# Helper function that makes the labels bold in the pheatmap 
make_bold_names <- function(mat, rc_fun, rc_names) {
  bold_names <- rc_fun(mat)
  ids <- rc_names %>% match(rc_fun(mat))
  ids %>%
    walk(
      function(i)
        bold_names[i] <<-
        bquote(bold(.(rc_fun(mat)[i]))) %>%
        as.expression()
    )
  bold_names
}
```


```{r}
# Read variant df
variants_df <- read.csv("/Users/pqh443/Documents/Git_projects/WP2_SweetProteinDiscovery/sweet_protein_variants/variant_df.csv", check.names = FALSE)

prep_corr_matrix <- function(input_df, protein = NA){
  
  # Keep only rows for the input protein
  if(!is.na(protein)){
      input_df <- input_df[input_df$sweet_protein == protein,]
  }
  # Drop columns
  drop = c("sweet_protein", "strain","protein", "plasmid", "mutation", "sequence", "ΔTm")
  input_df = input_df[,!(names(input_df) %in% drop)]
  
  # Calculate correlation matrix using Spearman's rank correlation
  corr_matrix <- rcorr(as.matrix(input_df), type = "spearman")
  corr_matrix = data.frame(corr_matrix$r, check.names = FALSE)
  
  # Remove expression related features from the rows and keep the columns only
  drop = c("Tm", "Yield", "OD600", "Growth rate")
  corr_matrix = corr_matrix[,(names(corr_matrix) %in% drop)]
  corr_matrix <- corr_matrix[!(rownames(corr_matrix) %in% drop), ]
  corr_matrix$Group <- NA
  
  # List of MODLAMP features
  modlamp_features <- c("Charge (at pH 7.4)", "Charge density", "Isoelectric point", "Instability index", "Aromaticity","Aliphatic index", "Boman index", "Hydrophobic ratio", "Sidechain bulkiness", "PEPCATS", "Amino acid polarity", "PPCALI", "Number of cysteines", "T-scale")
  
  # List of stability predictions 
  stability_predictions <- c("ΔΔG (Rosetta)", "ΔΔG (DynaMut2)")
  
  # List of structural feature columns
  structural_features <- c("Avg. surface charge", "Avg. surface hbond", "Avg. surface hydrophobicity", "Avg. pLDDT", "Total SASA", "Polar SASA", "Apolar SASA")
  
  # Make a group column that defines which type of feature each row represents
  for (row in 1:nrow(corr_matrix)) {
      index_name <- row.names(corr_matrix)[row]
      if(index_name %in% modlamp_features) {
          corr_matrix[row, "Group"] <- "Sequence features"
      } else if(index_name %in% stability_predictions) {
          corr_matrix[row, "Group"] <- "Stability predictors"
      } else if (index_name %in% structural_features) {
          corr_matrix[row, "Group"] <- "Structural features"
      }
  }

  # Cluster the features within each feature group 
  # Split dataframe based on group
  df_list <- split(corr_matrix, corr_matrix$Group)
  
  # Perform hierarchical clustering within each group and reorder rows
  df_reordered <- lapply(df_list, function(sub_df) {
    
    # Exclude the group column for clustering
    data_for_clustering <- sub_df[, -which(names(sub_df) == "Group")]
    
    # Perform hierarchical clustering
    hc <- hclust(dist(data_for_clustering))
    
    # Reorder the rows based on clustering
    sub_df_reordered <- sub_df[hc$order, ]
    
    return(sub_df_reordered)
  })
  
  # Combine the reordered dataframes back into a single dataframe
  corr_matrix <- do.call(rbind, df_reordered)
  rownames(corr_matrix) <- sub("^[^.]*\\.", "", rownames(corr_matrix))

  return(corr_matrix)
}

# Drop Yield column
variants_df <- variants_df[,!(names(variants_df) %in% "Yield")]

# Create correlation matrices for each sweet protein at a time and for all of them at once
corr_matrix_all = prep_corr_matrix(variants_df)
corr_matrix_brazzein = prep_corr_matrix(variants_df, "Brazzein")
corr_matrix_mnei = prep_corr_matrix(variants_df, "MNEI")
corr_matrix_thaumatin = prep_corr_matrix(variants_df, "Thaumatin-II")

# Get the order of the variables from the correlation matrix with all the data
group_column <- subset(corr_matrix_all, select = Group)
corr_matrix <- subset(corr_matrix_all, select = -Group)
row.names(group_column) <- row.names(corr_matrix_all)

# Drop group column 
corr_matrix_brazzein <- subset(corr_matrix_brazzein, select = -Group)
corr_matrix_mnei <- subset(corr_matrix_mnei, select = -Group)
corr_matrix_thaumatin <- subset(corr_matrix_thaumatin, select = -Group)

# Reorder rows 
corr_matrix_brazzein <- corr_matrix_brazzein[rownames(corr_matrix_all),]
corr_matrix_mnei <- corr_matrix_mnei[rownames(corr_matrix_all),]
corr_matrix_thaumatin <- corr_matrix_thaumatin[rownames(corr_matrix_all),]
```

```{r}
get_corr_mat <- function(input_df, protein){
  # Keep only rows for the input protein
  input_df <- input_df[input_df$sweet_protein == protein,]
  
  # Drop columns
  drop = c("sweet_protein", "strain","protein", "plasmid", "mutation", "sequence", "ΔTm")
  input_df = input_df[,!(names(input_df) %in% drop)]
  
  # Calculate correlation matrix and adjust p-values
  corr_mat <- rcorr(as.matrix(input_df), type = "spearman")
  
  return(corr_mat)
}

clean_df <- function(df, drop){
  # Drop columns and rows 
  df = df[,(names(df) %in% drop)]
  df <- df[!(rownames(df) %in% drop), ]
  return(df)
}

correct_corr_mat <- function(input_df, protein){

  # Calculate raw correlations 
  corr_mat <- get_corr_mat(input_df, protein)
  
  # Get p-values from the returned object
  pval_mat <- as.matrix(corr_mat$P)
  pval_vector <- as.vector(corr_mat$P)
  
  # Adjust the p-values using the Benjamini & Hochberg method
  adjusted_pvals <- p.adjust(pval_vector, method = "BH")
  
  # Reshape the adjusted p-values back into a matrix
  adjusted_pval_matrix <- matrix(adjusted_pvals, nrow = nrow(pval_mat), ncol = ncol(pval_mat))
  adjusted_pval_df <- data.frame(adjusted_pval_matrix, check.names = F)
  
  # Replace non-significant p-values with an empty string
  r_matrix <- as.matrix(corr_mat$r)
  r_matrix = data.frame(r_matrix, check.names = F)
  r_matrix[adjusted_pval_df >= 0.05] = 0.0
  
  # Drop columns and rows 
  r_df <- clean_df(r_matrix, c("Tm", "Yield", "OD600", "Growth rate"))

  return(r_df)
}

thaumatin_sign_corr <- correct_corr_mat(variants_df, "Thaumatin-II")
mnei_sign_corr <- correct_corr_mat(variants_df, "MNEI")
brazzein_sign_corr <- correct_corr_mat(variants_df, "Brazzein")

thaumatin_sign_corr <- thaumatin_sign_corr[rownames(corr_matrix_all),]
brazzein_sign_corr <- brazzein_sign_corr[rownames(corr_matrix_all),]
mnei_sign_corr <- mnei_sign_corr[rownames(corr_matrix_all),]

thaumatin_unadjusted <- get_corr_mat(variants_df, "Thaumatin-II")
thaumatin_unadjusted <- as.data.frame(thaumatin_unadjusted$P, check.names =F)
thaumatin_unadjusted <- clean_df(thaumatin_unadjusted, c("Tm", "Yield", "OD600", "Growth rate"))
thaumatin_unadjusted <- thaumatin_unadjusted[rownames(thaumatin_sign_corr), colnames(thaumatin_sign_corr)]

mnei_unadjusted <- get_corr_mat(variants_df, "MNEI")
mnei_unadjusted <- as.data.frame(mnei_unadjusted$P, check.names =F)
mnei_unadjusted <- clean_df(mnei_unadjusted, c("Tm", "Yield", "OD600", "Growth rate"))
mnei_unadjusted <- mnei_unadjusted[rownames(mnei_sign_corr), colnames(mnei_sign_corr)]

brazzein_unadjusted <- get_corr_mat(variants_df, "Brazzein")
brazzein_unadjusted <- as.data.frame(brazzein_unadjusted$P, check.names =F)
brazzein_unadjusted <- clean_df(brazzein_unadjusted, c("Tm", "Yield", "OD600", "Growth rate"))
brazzein_unadjusted <- brazzein_unadjusted[rownames(brazzein_sign_corr), colnames(brazzein_sign_corr)]

print("Raw p-values:")
print(paste("Thaumatin-II: ", thaumatin_unadjusted[thaumatin_sign_corr != 0]))
print(paste("Brazzein: ", brazzein_unadjusted[brazzein_sign_corr != 0]))
print(paste("MNEI: ", mnei_unadjusted[mnei_sign_corr != 0]))
```

```{r}
my_colour = list(
    Group = c("Sequence features" = "#f89e44", "Stability predictors" = "#e14f67", "Structural features" = "#aa317a")
)
threshold = 0.5
cellsize = 30
legend_breaks <- seq(from = -1, to = 1, by = 0.001)
legend_labels = seq(from = -1, to = 1, by = 0.001)
fontsize = 20
fontsize_number = 12
label_fontsize = 15
plot_width = 20
plot_height = 12
tree_height = 20
clustered = F

# Correlation plot for Brazzein
brazzein_labels <- brazzein_sign_corr
brazzein_labels <- brazzein_labels %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ifelse(abs(.) == 0, "", round(., 2))))

brazzein_plot <- pheatmap::pheatmap(
  fontsize = fontsize,
  fontsize_number = fontsize_number,
  mat = as.matrix(corr_matrix_brazzein), 
  main = "Brazzein",
  annotation_row = group_column, 
  annotation_names_row = F,
  show_rownames = F,
  annotation_colors = my_colour,
  labels_row = make_bold_names(corr_matrix_brazzein, rownames, rownames(corr_matrix_brazzein)),
  labels_col = make_bold_names(corr_matrix_brazzein, colnames, colnames(corr_matrix_brazzein)),
  cluster_rows = T,
  cluster_cols = T,
  cellwidth = cellsize,
  cellheight = cellsize,
  breaks = legend_breaks,
  angle_col = 45,
  fontsize_row = label_fontsize,
  fontsize_col = label_fontsize,
  treeheight_col = tree_height,
  treeheight_row = 50,
  fontfamily= "Arial",
  color=colorRampPalette(c("#aa317a", "white", "#f89e44"))(length(legend_breaks)),
  border_color = NA,
  number_color = "black",
  display_numbers = as.matrix(brazzein_labels),
  legend = F,
  annotation_legend = F
)

# Save clustering from the brazzein plot to use for other sweet proteins
row_clustering <- brazzein_plot$tree_row
col_clustering <- brazzein_plot$tree_col
```
